dialysis.checklist: Is the dialysis unit running this week? How many machines? Walk-in or referral only? Cost per session?

peritoneal_dialysis.checklist: Do you start and follow up peritoneal dialysis (CAPD) patients? Is a nephrologist on staff?

icu.checklist: How many ICU beds, and are any free now? Is there a doctor in the ICU at night? Ventilators?

nicu.checklist: What NICU level? Can you take a baby under 1.5 kg? Is a neonatologist or paediatrician there 24 hours?

picu.checklist: Do you admit children to an intensive care unit? Paediatric ventilators?

c_section.checklist: Can you do an emergency C-section at night? Is an anaesthetist available 24 hours? Blood on site?

cardiac_surgery.checklist: Which heart operations were done here in the last month? Is the cardiac surgeon on staff or visiting?

cath_lab_angioplasty.checklist: Is the cath lab open 24 hours for heart attacks? Is the interventional cardiologist on staff?

mri.checklist: Is the MRI working today? Waiting time? Is a radiologist reporting on site?

pet_ct.checklist: Is the PET-CT working? Which scans (FDG, PSMA)? Waiting time?

ct_scan.checklist: Is the CT scanner working now? Open at night? How fast is the report?

trauma_center.checklist: Do you take road-accident patients 24 hours? Is a surgeon and an orthopaedic surgeon there at night? CT on site?

emergency_24x7.checklist: Is a doctor in the emergency room at night? Do you have an ambulance?

burn_care.checklist: Do you admit burn patients? Is there a burns ward or ICU? Plastic surgeon on staff?

chemotherapy.checklist: Is a medical oncologist on staff? Can treatment start this week? Day-care chairs?

radiotherapy.checklist: Which radiotherapy machine is working? Waiting list length? Radiation oncologist on staff?

blood_bank.checklist: Is the blood bank on site and licensed? Is the needed blood group usually in stock?

ventilator.checklist: How many ventilators, and are any free now? Who manages ventilated patients at night?

xray.checklist: Is the X-ray machine working today? Can you X-ray an injury without an appointment?

ultrasound.checklist: Is the ultrasound available today, and is a radiologist or sonologist present?

cardiac_diagnostics.checklist: Can you do an ECG (or echo) today, and is a doctor available to read it?

orthopedic_surgery.checklist: Is an orthopaedic surgeon available? Can you X-ray and plaster on site? Operation theatre for bones?

maternity.checklist: Is a gynaecologist or midwife available now? Is the labour room open 24 hours?

eye_care.checklist: When is the next cataract surgery day? Is it free or covered by a scheme?

ambulance.checklist: Can you send an ambulance now, and how long will it take?

physiotherapy_rehab.checklist: Is a physiotherapist available, and on which days? What does a session cost?

ent.checklist: Is an ENT doctor available, and when? Do you do hearing tests on site?

dermatology.checklist: Is a skin doctor (dermatologist) available, and when?

psychiatry.checklist: Is a psychiatrist or counsellor available, and when? Do you see patients without an appointment?

lab_pathology.checklist: Can you do this test today, and when are results ready? Do I need to come fasting?

pediatrics.checklist: Is a child specialist available today? What are the OPD timings?

dental.checklist: Is a dentist available today? Do you do dental X-rays on site?

anti_venom.checklist: Do you have anti-snake venom (ASV) in stock right now? Is a doctor available to give it now?
